title: Fancy Zones Frees my Computer
summary: The supplied archive establishes a two-display configuration, startup work-area initialization and window-repositioning settings, but not the scope or blocked thread of the reported freeze. Clarify whether the desktop or only FancyZones stops responding before changing topology or overlay lifetime logic.

next_action.label: Clarify startup freeze and recovery
next_action.reason: Thanks for the attached report; it already records two active displays and the FancyZones positioning/overlay settings. Please clarify whether the pointer, taskbar and other applications also stop responding, or only the zones/drag operation. Which exact process do you force quit and reopen to recover? Does waiting until the desktop and both displays have settled before the first Shift-drag avoid it, and does toggling only FancyZones off/on recover it? These controls separate a desktop-wide freeze from startup module state; no replacement report is needed yet.

judgment.rationale: The supplied archive establishes a two-display configuration, startup work-area initialization and window-repositioning settings, but not the scope or blocked thread of the reported freeze. evidence: 0.102.3101 after auto-update; after startup windows reopen in unexpected places and Shift-drag overlay is absent or freezes.
Restarting the process described as 'PowerPlay' restores behavior until the next startup; the exact restarted executable is not identified.
The archive enumerates two active displays, Shift-drag and show-on-all-monitors enabled, spanning disabled, and move-on-display-change/last-zone/open-on-active-monitor enabled.
The November 16 FancyZones log records initialization and subsequent window-history queries; its exported WER fragment is an older November 5 APPCRASH and does not identify this startup freeze.
Inspected supplied settings, monitor report, latest FancyZones log and exported FancyZones WER fragment: https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34888950/PowerToysReport_2026-11-16-08-36-35.zip

Initialization/display changes rebuild work areas; current code already aborts active drags before clearing work-area ownership: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/82bd57f5d23ee19a98b0c46f42c304742a7db426/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp
Existing abort-before-clear safeguards must be retained, not reproposed as though absent.

plan: Reproduce cold-start versus delayed module startup with the archive's two-monitor settings and identify the first nonresponsive component.
If startup publishes an incomplete topology generation, atomically publish usable work areas before accepting overlay/drag requests, preserving existing drag cancellation.
Keep startup positioning and overlay rendering tests separate; avoid fixed startup sleeps as a substitute for a confirmed readiness boundary.
verification: Both monitors accept Shift-drag after cold startup without a process restart.
Display reconnect and saved-window restoration remain correct, with no active-drag access to replaced work areas.
